The structure of Mn3FeN crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms—Mn6Fe2N2—distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe and N each coordinated by six Mn neighbors, while Mn has 14 geometric neighbors (2 Fe, 2 N, 10 Mn). Polyhedral sharing among Mn-centered 14-vertex coordination polyhedra includes corner, edge, and face contacts, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component.
